info.title: SorobanPool API
info.description: Bearer JWT unless an operation is public. Errors are {error, message}.

minUnits.description: Pool size at which this price break starts

id.description: Stable keyset cursor for this event

type.description: created | joined | increased | left | price_break | filled | dispatched | ...

message.description: Plain-language description, never containing a full address

actor.description: Truncated address, present only on member events visible to participants

nextCursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= for the next page; also returned as X-Next-Cursor

example.trustMessage: Your money is held safely. The supplier is paid only after the goods arrive. If the group does not fill, you get everything back automatically.

example.note: Naira amounts are indicative. You pay the current tier price now; if the pool reaches a better tier you are refunded the difference automatically.
